name: WEBA Score Display
author: robbiehendry

sections.description:
WEBA Score Display lets lawn bowls clubs embed their live scoring display boards and tournament scoreboards on any WordPress page or post — no sign-in or visitor interaction required.

Boards update in real time as scores are entered in the WEBA Score app, so spectators on your club website see the same live view as any TV or device at the green.

Features

  • Embed a live club display board showing all active matches
  • Embed a tournament scoreboard for spectators to follow live
  • Simple shortcode — paste your share code and you’re done
  • Gutenberg block with live preview in the editor
  • No visitor interaction required — boards load and update automatically
  • Responsive iframe that fits any page layout

Requirements

  • An active WEBA Score club account — webascore.co.uk
  • A share code from the WEBA Score app (found under Display Boards or when sharing a tournament)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/webascore-display-board/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → WEBA Score Display and enter your share code(s).
  4. Add the shortcode [webascore_board] to any page or post.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my share code?

Open the WEBA Score app, go to Display Boards, and tap the board you want to share. The share code is displayed on that screen. For a tournament, tap Share on the tournament page.

What is the format of a club board share code?

Club board share codes are your club code followed by a dash and four digits — for example, if your club code is MYCLUB, your share code might look like MYCLUB-4821.

What is the format of a tournament share code?

Tournament share codes are six alphanumeric characters, for example ABC123.

Can I embed more than one board on a page?

Yes. Use the shortcode multiple times with different share codes:
[webascore_board share_code=”MYCLUB-1234″]
[webascore_board type=”tournament” share_code=”ABC123″]

Can I change the height of the board?

Yes. Add a height attribute to the shortcode:
[webascore_board height=”800″]

Does this work with the Gutenberg block editor?

Yes. Search for WEBA Score Board in the block inserter (under Embeds). You can set the board type, share code, and height from the block settings panel without writing any shortcode.

Do visitors need to sign in to WEBA Score?

No. Display boards and tournament scoreboards are publicly accessible via share code. No account or sign-in is needed to view them.
